en: Kill... me... plea...se...
All right...
Cain!? Hold on, what are you doing!?

jp: どうしても無理なんだね？
en: There's really... truly nothing to be done?
Yes.
Until she dies... until the very moment she dies,
she'll just go on hurting and suffering?
Yes...

jp: させられるはずないでしょ！！
en: Stop it!! There's no way I'll let you do something so insane!!

jp: ちゃんとわかって言ってるの！？
その子を、殺しちゃうのよ？
en: Do you even understand what you're saying!? You'd be killing that child!
Quiet, for a moment.

jp: 冷血の黒羽根がごちゃごちゃ
en: What!! Don't you cold-blooded black-wings start lecturing me!!
Shut up!!

jp: な、何よ突然大声だして！！

jp: もうこれ以上、しゃべるな
en: ...Sorry, Stayen. But don't say any more.

jp: あんたも悪魔の意見に
en: You're going to side with the demons too?
I thought better of you!!

jp: 言い出せるわけないだろう？
en: There's no way Cain would say something like this lightly, is there?
That's...

jp: 頼まれたのはあいつだ
それに応えたのもあいつ自身だ
あいつの気持ちも、考えろよ
en: She asked him. And he's the one who answered. Think about how he feels, too.
But... I can't stand to watch this!!

jp: 背負わせたりするんじゃない
en: Don't look away. Don't make him carry it all alone.
...That's right.

jp: それを見届ける者全てが
同じ罪を背負うのよ・・・
en: Everyone here who watches it through bears the same sin...
Cain...
...Kh

jp: うわぁぁぁぁぁぁぁぁぁ！！！
en: Uwaaaaaaaaaaah!!!
......I'm sorry.
...Thank... you.

jp: 証だから・・・・・・
en: Keep it... It's proof... that ...... lived......
...Ah
...This is... a Pain Ring?

jp: キミに、あげるよ・・・
en: I'm giving it... to you...
To me? ...Why?

jp: 生きてきた証だから・・・
en: It's proof... that ...... lived... Remember it...
......'s name is--
...Wait!! I can't hear you! Your name, one more time!!

jp: その子、もう死んだわ・・・
en: It's no use. That child... is already dead...

jp: 名前、ちゃんと聞けなかった
en: ...It was her last moment, and I couldn't even catch her name.

jp: お前、頑張ったんだから
en: ...That's enough. You did your best.
...But... ugh...

jp: うああああああああああ！！
en: Uwaaaaaaaaaaah!!
Cain...

jp: あんたはよくやったよ
en: You did well.

jp: あいつにやらせちまった
en: We made him take the hardest role of all.

jp: 選ばれたのはあいつだ
en: He was the one chosen.

jp: 死にゆく者の願いに応えると
en: And he chose, himself, to answer the wish of the dying.

jp: だけど、俺たちって無力だよな
見てることしか出来ないんだ
en: I know. But we're powerless, aren't we? All we could do was watch.

jp: 最後まで、死から目を背けずに
見ていられただけマシだ
en: ......Hmph. Be glad we could at least watch to the end without turning from death.

jp: ザイオンは慣れてるのか
en: Are you used to this kind of thing, Zion?

jp: だが、慣れてしまうことと
何も感じないのとは意味が違う
en: I am used to death. But being used to it and feeling nothing are not the same.
Kill... me... hur...ry...

jp: やっぱりボクには出来ないよ
en: ...I'm sorry. I just can't do it after all.
...Move.
Zion?
I'll do it.

jp: あんた、何言ってるのよ！！
en: Hold on, Zion!! What are you saying!!

jp: お前たちがやらないなら
en: If you won't do it, I will.
Zion...
Move, Cain. Don't get in my way.

jp: あんたたち悪魔に命の重みなんか
en: Cold-blooded! You're the worst! You demons can't understand the weight of a life!!

jp: その＜命の重み＞を背負う
en: ...And are you prepared to bear that "weight of a life" yourselves?
...Huh?
I'll end it quickly.
Hey, Zion...

en: What, still have complaints?

jp: いや・・・文句じゃない
ただ、お前にこういう役目を
任せちまってさ・・・

...Sorry.
If you're sorry, then don't look away.
Zion!! Stop!
Move, Cain.
That's not it! ...There's no need anymore!!
Because this child... is already dead...
...Huh?
She was far more worn down than we thought.

jp: この子も眠ることが出来るわ
en: But now, at last, this child can sleep.

jp: もう、痛みに苦しむことも

jp: もう苦しまないですむの
en: Yes, that's right. She doesn't have to suffer anymore.

jp: ごめんなさい、ザイオン

jp: わからないけど・・・

jp: それぐらいにしてやりな

...Luca

だったら死に対しても
強くならなきゃいけないよ

Strong, in the face of death?
...That's right.

jp: 死に慣れても、死に対して
無感覚にならなければいい
必要なのは己の胸に死を刻むこと
en: Be used to death, but never numb to it. What matters is to carve it into your heart.

jp: 黒羽根たちの戒めの言葉か？
en: ...Is that a precept of the black-wings?

jp: 俺たちの一族に伝わる言葉だ
戦士が忘れてはならない
自戒の言葉として・・
en: Words passed down in our clan. A warning no warrior must ever forget...

jp: その戒めの言葉を忘れ
禁断のペインリングを持ち出し
en: The one who forgot that precept, took the forbidden Pain Ring and fled... was Aragi.

jp: あいつには、死なんて言葉
何の意味も持たないのよ
en: To him, the word "death" means nothing at all.
Carve death into my heart...

jp: 俺たちは、乗り越えた屍を
無意味にしちゃいけないんだよな
en: ...Yeah, you're right. We mustn't let the dead we've stepped past be for nothing.

jp: ボクは、忘れたりしないよ
en: I won't ever forget her. That child...
Young man
